selection_policy: From the frozen 2026-10-17 tag catalog, retain numeric stable main-project releases 10.0+ and the existing three documented mainline exclusions. Group the 70 eligible releases into 45 distinct MAJOR.MINOR families, ordered by each family's first release date. Select family ranks round(i*(45-1)/(30-1)) for i=0..29. Within each selected family choose its highest eligible stable patch, except that the first family uses the oldest boundary release 10.0 to preserve the historical start. The final family uses its latest eligible release 33.7.2. Exactly 30 distinct families are represented once each. Spacing is uniform in family rank, not calendar time, and adjacent selected families can be consecutive. Patch representatives are not repeated observations of the same family. Use plain artifacts before 23.1 and JRE artifacts thereafter. Selection uses no graphs, clusters, MQ values, or structural-change outcomes.
artifact_source: Maven Central released Guava artifacts. Published SHA1 sidecars checked and immutable SHA256 pins recorded.
external_exclusions: Project-owned production sources under com.google.common and com.google.thirdparty.publicsuffix define the ownership scope
The public-suffix Java implementation carries Guava Authors headers and is included; package naming alone does not establish external ownership
JDK, failureaccess, listenablefuture compatibility artifact, external annotation libraries, and other external endpoints are excluded
Android, GWT, test, benchmark, and auxiliary-component artifacts are outside the production JRE study
Prerelease distributions are excluded; a Beta API annotation does not exclude the annotated Guava class
